AGO.short: Since 2026 taxes are paid electronically through the tax portal; no source found says returns can be filed online.
AGO.summary: The 2025 state budget allots Kz 23 billion to the tax authority AGT for its SIGT/SIIAT digital transformation project. In September 2026 CIAT authors described AGT's Integrated Tax Management System (SIGT) as meant to take tax procedures off paper, from registration and returns to payment. In July 2026 AGT ruled that taxes are, as a general rule, paid electronically through its Portal do Contribuinte. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxpayers can file returns online. Establishing would need taxpayers to be able to file returns online for at least one core tax.

BDI.short: Large and medium taxpayers could file and pay taxes online in 2023; no source found says whether filing online is mandatory or most used.
BDI.summary: In November 2023 the revenue authority (OBR) said large and medium taxpayers file returns online. They have done so on its Umutangakori portal since 1 August 2023. The OBR also said taxes are paid online there, with receipts issued the same way. In the last twelve months, Burundi Times reported in January 2026 that the OBR had begun implementing E-KORI. It is a new platform for online declaration and payment, with World Bank support. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

BEN.short: Taxes could be filed online and paid electronically in 2024; no source found reports mandatory or majority online filing.
BEN.summary: On 23 May 2024 the Direction générale des impôts launched its e-services portal in Cotonou, where small businesses and individuals declare income online. A circular of 16 September 2025 made tax stamps and deed registration online only, with payment through e-services.impots.bj. Through the SIGIBé system taxpayers pay online, mostly by mobile money, and the tax directorate's 2025 report puts electronic payments above 96% for most taxes. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing of returns is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

BFA.short: Taxes could be filed online and paid electronically in 2026; no source found reports mandatory or majority online filing.
BFA.summary: The tax directorate's eSINTAX platform has been online since April 2018 for large and mid-size enterprises. Online payment became compulsory for large enterprises from 1 January 2020. The directorate also said they have had to file through the portal since 1 January 2019. In the last twelve months, leFaso.net reported in November 2026 that the eSINTAX JAVA portal lets taxpayers file declarations and pay taxes remotely. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

BWA.short: Most individual tax returns were filed online in 2024; no source found reports electronic payment through the tax authority.
BWA.summary: In July 2025 BURS board chairperson Lesedi Senatla urged taxpayers to file 2025 individual returns through the e-services portal and Mtax app. The season ran from 1 July to 30 September 2025. In July 2024 Commissioner General Janet Makgolo said 77% of the 38,000 individual returns filed in the previous financial year were submitted online. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxes can be paid electronically through the tax authority's system. Operating would need taxes paid online, by bank transfer or by mobile money, through the tax authority's system.

CAF.short: Since 2025 large taxpayers must file and pay taxes online; no source found reports the share of returns filed online.
CAF.summary: The tax directorate (DGID) launched e-Tax for online returns on 24 March 2025, and e-Tax has taken online payment of taxes since then. In a communiqué of 7 August 2025 the finance minister required large taxpayers to file on e-Tax. Those who did not faced systematic audits from early September 2025. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No share of returns filed online has been found. In the same communiqué the minister said more than half of the firms concerned still did not use the platform.

CIV.short: Nothing found since 2023 names online tax filing and payment, so no stage is set.
CIV.summary: No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether tax returns can be filed online in Côte d'Ivoire. Nothing has been found either that says returns are filed and taxes paid on paper. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source from the past three years names an online tax filing or payment service for the country. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says tax returns are filed and taxes paid on paper.

CMR.short: Taxes could be filed and paid online through the tax directorate's platforms in 2026; no source found says how many returns are filed online.
CMR.summary: LeFisk reported in August 2026 that the tax directorate takes returns online through ATOM, and that it has since put the registration of deeds on a new platform. Registration duties on public-procurement contracts are assessed and paid online on registrations.dgi.cm, by Mobile Money, Orange Money or a DGI code. Only three of the 120 deeds listed were open. Tele-declaration began in 2016 for the largest taxpayers and was extended in 2022 to the local and individual taxpayer centres. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

COD.short: Tax returns could be filed online in 2026; no source found reports electronic payment.
COD.summary: Finance minister Doudou Fwamba said on RTNC that VAT tele-declaration (e-filing) has been generalised at the Direction generale des impots, according to a report of September 2026. He also said the E-Finance programme, structured with Huawei, mobilises over US$150m. It funds applications including the tax directorate's ERP. He listed the generalisation among the public-finance reforms carried out in August 2026. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxes can be paid electronically through the tax authority's system. Operating would need taxes to be paid online, by bank transfer or by mobile money, through the tax authority's system.

COG.short: Taxes could be filed online and paid electronically in 2026; no source found reports mandatory or majority online filing.
COG.summary: L'Economie reports that since 3 August 2026 taxpayers pay taxes and levies online through the Fouta national switch, after declaring on E-Tax. In November 2024 MTN Congo said an e-tax declaration made on impots.gouv.cg can be paid by MTN Mobile Money. In the last twelve months, the finance minister said FCFA 94 billion of tax was collected through e-Tax via FOUTA. That covers 1 June to 16 November 2026. The ministry says FOUTA is being deployed in three phases. All taxpayers are due by the end of 2026. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

COM.short: An electronic tax system was under way in 2026; online filing is not on record.
COM.summary: The Directorate General of Taxes launched a three-day workshop on 15 April 2026, funded by AFD through PAGFSI. It was to prepare the progressive deployment of tax e-filing (télédéclaration) and e-payment (télépaiement) under the 2026 finance law. The Directorate's own report says the workshop was also to validate the legal framework. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says tax returns can be filed online. Establishing would need taxpayers to be able to file returns online for at least one core tax.

CPV.short: Tax returns could be filed online in 2024; no source found reports electronic payment.
CPV.summary: In May 2024 the tax directorate (DNRE) said tax returns are submitted electronically through its portal. It moved the 2024 deadline from 31 May to 14 June after an outage was cleared. From 11 February 2019 the DNRE and the Casa do Cidadao offered online payment of taxes by bank card on the citizen portal. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxes can be paid electronically through the tax authority's system. Operating would need taxes to be paid online, by bank transfer or by mobile money, through the tax authority's system.

DJI.short: An electronic tax system was under way in 2026; online filing is not on record.
DJI.summary: A World Bank status report put the share of tax returns filed and paid on time through ITAS at 0 as of 9 January 2026. Its target is 70% by December 2029. The World Bank's US$20m Economic and Financial Governance Project includes tax administration modernisation and revenue administration digitalisation. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says tax returns can be filed online. Establishing would need taxpayers to be able to file returns online for at least one core tax.

DZA.short: Online filing was mandatory or used by most taxpayers in 2026.
DZA.summary: In May 2026 the tax directorate (DGI) extended its Jibayatic tele-declaration and tele-payment system to all local tax offices, under DGI instruction 31/2026 of 6 May 2026. In the last twelve months, the mandate to file electronically grew: until that instruction only large-enterprise (DGE) taxpayers had to file electronically. The instruction also makes it mandatory for real-profit regime taxpayers and simplified non-commercial professions. From May 2026 taxpayers of tax centres, proximity centres and inspections can pay taxes remotely through Jibayatic. The DGI said in July 2026 that payment through Jibayatic is by CIB or Edahabia card or bank transfer.

EGY.short: Taxes could be filed online and paid electronically in 2026; no source found reports mandatory or majority online filing.
EGY.summary: Egyptian Tax Authority head Rasha Abdel Aal said in August 2026 that taxpayers have started creating accounts and submitting returns electronically. In October 2025 the authority's head said employers compute wage tax on its unified platform, by payroll integration, spreadsheet upload or manual entry. Finance minister Ahmed Kouchouk said real estate transactions tax can be paid electronically by bank cards or direct-debit cards. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

ERI.short: Nothing found since 2023 names online tax filing and payment, so no stage is set.
ERI.summary: No stage is set. The only item found is ERITAS, named in an African Development Bank project appraisal report. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether tax returns can be filed online in Eritrea. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows an e-filing system procured, piloted or being built. Preparing would need an integrated tax administration or e-filing system procured, piloted or being built.

ETH.short: Tax returns could be filed online in 2024; no source found reports electronic payment.
ETH.summary: A January 2024 ICTD paper examines the adoption rate trend of the e-filing system among large and medium taxpayers. In January 2024 the Ministry of Revenues announced it would extend its e-tax system across tax bureaus, Addis Fortune reports. In the last twelve months, on 8 October 2026 the Ministry of Revenue re-advertised for a Technical Lead/Chief Architect for the Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS). The World Bank finances the post. The Executive Budget Proposal for 2024/25 lists an ITAS capital project at ETB 26,671,900. No source found since October 2023 says taxes can be paid electronically through the tax authority's system. Operating would need taxes to be paid online, by bank transfer or by mobile money, through the tax authority's system.

GAB.short: Taxes could be filed online and paid electronically in 2025; no source found reports mandatory or majority online filing.
GAB.summary: The tax directorate announced an e-tax portal for online tax returns and payment on 18 August 2025. Since 10 July 2025 small taxpayers can declare and pay by phone through e-Tax. In the last twelve months, eTax was being brought into the Gabon Connect portal in October 2026, the directorate's flyer says. A single online monthly salary declaration opened there on 21 October for the 440 firms of the large-enterprises directorate. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

GHA.short: Taxes could be filed online and paid electronically in 2026; no source found reports mandatory or majority online filing.
GHA.summary: The GRA is deploying its Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) as a single platform covering registration, filing, payment and accounting. In August 2026 MyJoyOnline reported that the ITAS pilot covers filing and payment of PAYE, VAT, VAT Withholding and Withholding VAT for selected taxpayers. Graphic Online reports that over 400 taxpayers from the Accra West Area Office were onboarded in phase one, with large taxpayers next. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

GIN.short: Taxes could be filed and paid online through the eTax platform in 2026; no source found says how many returns are filed online.
GIN.summary: In the last twelve months, We Are Tech reported in May 2026 that the government has launched eTax for filing tax returns online. It also takes tax payments online. In September 2020 the Budget Minister said pilot firms had begun filing on the eTax portal, launched that month. They had declared and paid GNF 45 billion through it. The 2020 figures cover pilot firms only, and the May 2026 report gives no count of users. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

GMB.short: An electronic tax system was under way in 2026; online filing is not on record.
GMB.summary: The GRA Commissioner General said in June 2026 that the new Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) will let taxpayers register, file returns, pay and access services online. A joint Ministry of Finance and GRA press release says the World Bank-supported ITAS is being implemented. An Arabsoft and Tunisie Micro-Informatique consortium was selected at USD 7,270,192.20 after the first awardee went bankrupt. That first contract, signed with Sogema Technologies in May 2024, was for a web-based ITAS with online filing to replace GAMTAXNET. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says tax returns can be filed online. Establishing would need taxpayers to be able to file returns online for at least one core tax.

GNB.short: Large and medium taxpayers must file tax returns online, and taxes can be paid by mobile money; no source found reports the share filed online.
GNB.summary: In July 2024 O Democrata GB reported that Kontaktu, the platform of the tax directorate (DGCI), lets taxpayers declare their taxes online, and pay by bank transfer, Orange Money and Mobile Money. The IMF says Kontaktu, an electronic filing and payment platform, was launched in 2021. An IMF report published in April 2024 says all large and medium taxpayers have had to file electronically since March 2022. It counted six electronic payment options in April 2024, up from none in March 2022. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No share of returns filed online has been found, and the mandate found is dated March 2022.

GNQ.short: Nothing found names online tax filing and payment or says there is none, so no stage is set.
GNQ.summary: Not found. Nothing found says how taxes are filed and paid.

KEN.short: Tax returns were filed online and taxes paid through the tax system in 2026; no source found says whether most returns are filed online.
KEN.summary: Kenya's revenue authority runs the iTax portal, where VAT returns have been filed since mid-August 2026 after the offline Excel template was dropped, The Star reported. In the last twelve months, export values from the customs system have been prefilled in the VAT return since May 2026. The Commissioner General said returns can be filed through a WhatsApp service run by an AI chatbot. They can also be filed by USSD code. Capital gains tax is paid through iTax, a law firm wrote in July 2024. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

LBR.short: Taxes could be filed online and paid electronically in 2026; no source found reports mandatory or majority online filing.
LBR.summary: The LRA said in August 2025 that its LITAS system handles online filing, assessments and payments. In April 2026 the LRA's head of systems said taxpayers generate payment slips and pay in real time on LITAS. In August 2026 the LRA's plan said LITAS return processing had been rolled out to one Tax Business Office, and tabled all modules rolled out to all offices as the expected result. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

LBY.short: An electronic tax system was under way in 2025; online filing is not on record.
LBY.summary: In December 2025 the Tax Authority announced that the Unified Tax System was officially in operation. It said digital platforms would be launched during 2026 under its digital transformation plan. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxpayers can file returns online, or pay taxes electronically, through the Unified Tax System. Establishing would need taxpayers to be able to file returns online for at least one core tax.

LSO.short: Taxes could be filed online and paid electronically in 2025; no source found reports mandatory or majority online filing.
LSO.summary: In June 2025 Revenue Services Lesotho said taxpayers register on its eTax platform, log in with a username and password and file their returns there. Its guide says returns for CIT, IIT, RIIT, T&E, VAT and PAYE can be submitted online. It says taxes can be paid through the e-Payments platform by mobile money (EcoCash and M-Pesa) and by bank EFT. LAA's Director General says the Automatic Compliance Project is in use, with RSL retrieving PAYE files as early as August 2024. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

MAR.short: Since 2026 foreign digital suppliers must file and pay VAT online, and other taxpayers can too; no source found reports the share filed online.
MAR.summary: In 2025 taxpayers filed 5,031,004 returns online through SIMPL, the DGI says, and 91.4% of tax revenue was paid online. In 2017 the DGI made electronic filing and payment mandatory for all firms, except those on the flat-rate regime. In the last twelve months, Decree 2.25.862 of 27 November 2025 required non-resident suppliers of digital services to register on the DGI's platform. They must file VAT returns and pay electronically. In May 2026 the DGI opened a platform called Taxation on Digital Services. No share of returns filed online has been found. The mandate found in the last three years covers non-resident suppliers of digital services only.

MDG.short: Tax returns could be filed and taxes paid online in 2025; no source found reports mandatory or majority online filing.
MDG.summary: In September 2025 finance minister Rindra Rabarinirinarison said the new Integrated Tax Administration System (SAFI) takes returns and payments online at any hour. The tax administration's steering committee reported SAFI tested and ready for production from the end of September 2025. SAFI went into production after the committee met on 18 September 2025, the tax administration said. The minister also said the e-Hetra system for declaring and paying taxes online has been extended nationwide. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

MLI.short: Taxes could be filed online and paid electronically in 2025; no source found reports mandatory or majority online filing.
MLI.summary: In November 2025 the director-general of Mali's tax directorate (DGI) said telefiling covers all taxpayers and all taxes, except a few such as registration duties and vignettes. An April 2026 notice says companies can file corporate and business income tax returns online with their accounts attached. Telepayment started in December 2021. The director-general said taxpayers of the computerised centres can pay by bank transfer, and that mobile money and card payment were not yet offered. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

MOZ.short: Tax returns could be filed online in 2026; no source found reports electronic payment.
MOZ.summary: PwC's page, last reviewed 11 August 2026, says the eDeclaração platform takes online income tax returns. It says the Contribuinte Portal takes monthly VAT returns, and manual filing is also allowed. Registered taxpayers generate a reference number online and pay VAT, PIT and CIT through their bank. In March 2022 the tax authority said e-Declaracao took VAT, IRPC, IRPS and other returns. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxes can be paid electronically through the tax authority's system. Operating would need taxes to be paid online, by bank transfer or by mobile money, through the tax authority's system.

MRT.short: Taxes could be filed online and paid electronically in 2026; no source found reports mandatory or majority online filing.
MRT.summary: In September 2026 the tax directorate (DGI) said taxpayers can declare their taxes online through its STT system, which runs at stt.e-tax.impots.gov.mr. It said STT lets taxpayers pay their taxes online and add their means of payment. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory for some taxpayers or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

MUS.short: Online filing was mandatory or used by most taxpayers in 2026.
MUS.summary: The Mauritius Revenue Authority (MRA) says individuals file their 2025 income tax returns electronically, due by 15 October 2025. Its 2025 filing guide says individuals are legally required to submit income tax returns and pay electronically. Every company must file its return of income and pay tax electronically. Its 2022/23 annual report says it collected 98% of tax receipts through e-payment, and that tax returns were e-filed in almost all cases. No change has been found in the last twelve months. In 2026 the MRA said all VAT returns from foreign digital-service suppliers must be submitted electronically through its systems.

MWI.short: Malawi reported online tax filing in use in 2025; no source found since 2023 reports electronic payment.
MWI.summary: Malawi told the World Bank's GovTech survey in 2025 that e-filing is in use for tax and customs declarations. The same answer linked the Malawi Revenue Authority's Msonkho Online portal, a system the authority owns. In October 2026 the authority's representative said it is developing ITAS II, its second Integrated Tax Administration System, in-house, and is still seeking funding for it. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxes can be paid electronically through the tax authority's system. InnovRIM, which runs SahelFabLab, plans six weeks of incubation for 20 startups across Bassiknou and Dar Naim, in its 2026 Agri-Innovation Start-Up Cup. No source found since October 2023 places hubs with programmes in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

MUS.short: Incubators ran startup cohorts in 2026; hubs with programmes in more than one city are not on record.
MUS.summary: In the last twelve months, in March 2026, Turbine took ten Mauritian start-ups into its incubation programme, eight from its 2025 Innovation Challenge. On 17 September 2026 it launched the two-month 2026 Challenge with seven selected start-ups. In May 2026 La Plage Factory said six incubators operate in Mauritius and over 350 companies have been through incubation. Turbine is based in Port Louis. In June 2026 Namibia opened the US$2 million Ondangwa Digital Technology Hub, a centre for education, innovation and events. NGA.summary: KOICA and SMEDAN began the ACE Startup Academy founder training in Abuja on 24 August 2026. It took about 50 teams, chosen from 3,856 applicants. In the last twelve months, In April 2026 ONDI chose a hub in each state and the FCT as local partners for iHatch's fifth cohort. In July 2026 Nairametrics said the Ken Saro-Wiwa Innovation Hub in Port Harcourt runs incubation programmes and Genesys Tech Hub in Enugu a developer fellowship. It named no cohort. RWA.short: Government incubation hubs in seven districts ran startup cohorts in 2026; no source found says whether a technology park has tenants.
RWA.summary: RISA set up Hanga Hubs in seven districts: Musanze, Rwamagana, Huye, Muhanga, Nyagatare, Rubavu and Rusizi. RISA's Hanga Hubs run a nine-month programme for young entrepreneurs, from ideation through incubation. In the last twelve months, in June 2026, an 18-month acceleration programme for eight startups began: The Rwanda ICT Chamber runs the Mastercard Foundation EdTech Fellowship. Kigali Innovation City broke ground in September 2025. No source found since October 2023 says a science or technology park is in service with tenants. Mature would need a science or technology park in service with companies or startups as tenants.

SDN.short: An incubator ran startup cohorts in Port Sudan and Kassala in 2024; no technology park with tenants is on record.
SDN.summary: On 24 February 2024 the EU-funded WE-RISE! incubation and acceleration programme opened for over 300 startups and small firms in Kassala and Port Sudan. WE-RISE! runs its cohorts in both cities. In the last twelve months, in December 2025, 249Startups held the sixth Orange Corners Sudan demo day, where eight startups were chosen for funding. On 19 August 2026 Sudan launched its part of an AfDB-funded entrepreneurship project through the University of Khartoum's incubator. No source found since October 2023 says a science or technology park is in service with tenants. Mature would need a science or technology park in service with companies or startups as tenants.

Goin' Digital, an incubation programme under the telecoms ministry, ran a cohort of 21 startups from May to October 2026. In the last twelve months, On 29 October 2026 Senegal and the Gates Foundation launched an AI Scaling Hub in Dakar. A directory says Teranga Tech Incub's six-month programme is deployed in Dakar, Saint-Louis, Kaolack and Ziguinchor, and names no cohort. In November 2026 a FinTech Innovation Lab opened at the UniPod with UNCDF, the EU and the Bank of Sierra Leone. At least 12 start-ups are to receive incubation there. SYC.summary: In the last twelve months, in August 2026, SeyCCAT launched the Business, Technology and Innovation Incubator, with applications open for its 2026 cohort. It offers up to 12 months of incubation, mentoring and access to seed funding. The University of Seychelles says its Centre for Innovation, set up in 2025, serves as an incubator and accelerator. Its last phase was held at Djanta Tech Hub in Lomé. The ministry opened the 3,000 m² hub on 7 May 2026, for incubation, acceleration and mentoring of tech startups. TUN.short: Startup programmes ran in Tunis and Sousse in 2025 and 2026, and technoparks host hundreds of firms; no source found says how many are startups.

In March 2025 Sousse Innovation Hub's incubator and accelerator were supporting about fifty startups. In September 2025 Entreprises Magazine said El Ghazela Technopark hosts nearly 90 firms and the Manouba technopark more than 200. In the last twelve months, in October 2026, The Dot said it had supported over 500 startups since 2021. How many of the technoparks' tenants are startups has not been found.
